name: Usa (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Usa city emblem in green: an oval bearing a white stylised figure.
history: Municipal flag of Usa, a city in Ōita Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 31 March 2005.

features.role: Usa city emblem — an oval bearing a white stylised figure
